# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (non-secret; override secrets via `wrangler secret put`)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[vars]
DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM = "cloudflare"
DEPLOYMENT_MODE = "authenticated"
DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE = "public"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 object storage — artifacts, skill bundles, attachments, DB backups
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[r2_buckets]]
binding = "PAPERCLIP_STORAGE"
bucket_name = "paperclip-storage"
# preview_bucket_name = "paperclip-storage-preview"
